questions.explain: JSON is JavaScript Object Notation, a text-based data format.

questions.q: In JSON, what does a pair of square brackets [ ] represent?
questions.explain: Square brackets denote an ordered array/list.

questions.q: Which of these is a valid JSON number value for InvoiceAmount?
questions.explain: JSON numbers are written without quotes and without currency symbols or thousands separators.

questions.q: What is the difference between a field set to null and that field being left out of the JSON entirely?
options: null explicitly states the field has no value, while omitting it says nothing about the field at all
null means the field has an error
Omitting a field is invalid JSON
questions.explain: null is an explicit statement of 'no value', distinct from simply not including the key.

questions.q: Which rule is true about JSON object keys?
questions.explain: JSON requires keys to be double-quoted strings, and JSON is case-sensitive.
